blocks.name: seam_check
blocks.description: Pre-execution seam validation across adjacent pipeline nodes.

source.response_field: nodes, edges, input_schema_id, output_schema_id per node, from list_workspace_agents

blocks.why: Each adjacent pair is classified as SCHEMA MATCH (output_schema_id == input_schema_id — verified typed compatibility), LABEL MATCH (labels correspond but no typed schema — author assertion), UNMATCHED, or OPEN SLOT. Derived from the declared graph topology and agent schema IDs — not inferred. Coverage is partial because not all nodes declare schema IDs.

blocks.name: steps

source.response_field: execution envelope per delegation hop: agent, gate_input, gate_output, duration_ms, failure

blocks.why: Derived from envelope at each hop. If a stage fails, execution stops and subsequent steps are absent — the trace is honest about the boundary, not padded to look complete.

blocks.name: summary
blocks.description: Assessment of whether the pipeline shape fit the mission.
blocks.why: Inferred from the execution trace — which stages completed, where failure entered, whether an OPEN SLOT prevented execution. The 'better strategy' recommendation is the strategist's judgement.
